description: Designing and building custom backend architectures and database solutions for small-scale applications and automated tools.
highlights: Designed and normalized relational database schemas (3NF/BCNF) for e-commerce and library management systems using MySQL and DBML.
Built server-side applications using NestJS and Prisma ORM, implementing custom pipes and decorators to ensure data validation and clean code architecture.
Automated repository operational workflows by engineering custom Telegram bots integrated with GitHub Actions.
